newsitem.title: USA: Brent trades sideways in late U.S. paper dealings.
newsitem.headline: Brent trades sideways in late U.S. paper dealings.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude traded sideways in late U.S. paper dealings, traders said.
A European company sold a full boat of July Brent to a U.S. trader at $19.52 a barrel, even with the settlement of London's IPE.
A series of partials traded at $19.50 a barrel, two cents under the London close.
Intermonth spreads were talked slightly weaker. June/July Brent was at minus 20/16 cents, July/August at minus 14/13 cents and August/September at minus 11/9 cents.
